verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party capability to export all account data (workflows, events, data stores, connected accounts) in open formats. The REST API, the CLI's historical-event retrieval and the source-available components are developer building blocks, not an export feature. A community comment that workflows are portable Node.js code is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
